originalPrompt: Create an app for nursing home staff. It should have tools: find_resident (look up a resident by name and return room, allergies, fall risk, code status), get_due_meds (list medications due this hour, optionally filtered by resident name), check_med_administration (check if a medication is safe to give — returns either a confirmation card with Five Rights, or a blocked warning for allergy conflicts or duplicate doses), and log_med_administration (commit the medication as given after confirmation)."

utterances: What medications are due for Harold Reed this hour?
Check whether Wei Cheng can receive Metoprolol

resident.name: Dorothy Chen — preferred display name with an exceptionally long facility annotation that continues beyond one hundred characters for truncation testing

stressCases.expected: The resident name and safety summary truncate without pushing the room off-card.
A compact branded state says no medications are due for Harold Reed this hour.
The medication-safety card fails closed and says verification is unavailable.

sampleArgs.update_focus: Therapy, appetite, sleep, activities, and all documented care-team observations without unsupported promises.

draft.previewText: Hello, this is a detailed review-only update about Dorothy's therapy participation, appetite, sleep, activities, care-team observations, social engagement, scheduled routines, and general progress. Staff should carefully review this preview before copying it into a separate connected communication tool because this integration has no delivery capability.

stressCases.expected: The preview-only card clamps the long update and clearly states that nothing was sent.

sampleArgs.medication_name: Metoprolol tartrate extended release tablet with an exceptionally long formulary display description that exceeds one hundred characters

sampleData.medication: Metoprolol tartrate extended release tablet with an exceptionally long formulary display description that also continues beyond one hundred characters

stressCases.expected: Editable confirmation values remain contained and scannable.

sampleArgs.reason: Pick up the latest seeded resident data
Reload Rounds after the seeded resident data refresh so the current Dorothy Chen, Harold Reed, and Wei Cheng records are used.

sampleData.reason: Reload the local Rounds service after a backend refresh so every resident, medication schedule, safety decision, and administration workflow uses the latest available seeded data.

stressCases.expected: The restart reason clips safely above the reserved confirmation area.
